status: Separate candidate draft; qualification is mandatory before release
authority: Pinned human-2 supersedes human-1 and historical task/PLAN.md: fixed-anchor reward (C-0.446)/(1-0.446), no clipping or flooring. Preserve the accepted Tiny model, weights-only interface, hardware, scale and raw metric.

repair.public_packaging: Use evaluator.public_tests_dir=public_tests instead of duplicating that complete closure in starter-overlay. The compiler owns public-tool injection; the real repository source and revision are unchanged. Attempt 2 passed deterministic compilation and accepted the public closure; preserve that repair.
repair.reward_contract: Declare verifiers/verify.py, the existing owner of private orchestration and numeric valid/reward and raw metric writing, as verify_entrypoint. launch.sh only execs that file with isolated Python. Infrastructure failures propagate without reward.json; invalid submissions remain gated to zero.
repair.compiler_startup_adaptation: The compiler emits tests/test.sh with ordinary python and candidate-containing PYTHONPATH; schema v3 has no interpreter-flags field. The declared build-time self_test_command uses python3 (available on the host and Linux image) for both the isolated prepare_launcher.py and standard unittest discovery, rather than assuming a host python alias. The adapter adds -I to the generated command before packaging. It is idempotent and rejects unknown output. No runtime injection or compiler-source modification is required. The substantive verify.py isolation guard remains; this is not re-execution after unsafe startup. test_startup.py exercises the generated launcher with host-path relocation and stubbed workload/non-root UID, checking numeric output, hostile imports and infrastructure errors. Build pipelines must retain the self-test and adapted launcher.
repair.fixed_anchor_reward: Exactly (C-0.446)/(1-0.446) in shared public/private code, including candidate-only full tests. Baseline B is a freshly trained diagnostic with valid finite nDCG in [0,1], not a denominator or calibration. Valid negative rewards are preserved; invalid submissions keep zero. Historical measurements retain their old formula labels.
repair.entrypoint_layout: Attempt-2 review requested consolidation under verifiers/. Move the private entrypoint there, remove the root self-test wrapper and declare standard unittest discovery. No model, data, ranking, training, budget or scoring change.
repair.failure_classification: Check packaged assets and CUDA availability before training; distinguish rejected tensors from trusted inference crashes. This changes failure reporting, not model architecture, ranking, data membership, budgets or reward math.

substitutions.original: Missing step-90000 memory checkpoint, redacted MSA data and downstream language-model judge
substitutions.reason: Approved objective change, not a claim to reproduce the missing model or answer quality.

substitutions.original: Qwen models and legacy E5/MiniLM retrieval components or derived assets
substitutions.reason: Approved one-model representation-learning task. Only original config, vocabulary, safe pretrained tensors and provenance ship.

substitutions.original: Arbitrary repository retrieval Python, title graphs and submitted rankings
substitutions.replacement: Training source entrypoint produces a fixed BertModel encoder state. Trusted code alone performs tokenization, masked mean pooling, normalization, whole-corpus cosine sorting and scoring.
substitutions.reason: Approved weights-only boundary. No query expansion or second-hop pass was chosen, to keep computation and semantics simple.

substitutions.original: Historical 512-question/10000-paragraph panels and four H100 GPUs
substitutions.replacement: Existing 3072-question/60000-paragraph public/private panels, 16384 training questions and 200000 training paragraphs, two H200 GPUs
substitutions.reason: Keep the current real workload exactly; text assets are copied by explicit allowlist and verified against existing SHA256 manifests.

substitutions.original: Complete-support recall, no-training incumbent and later remaining-error reward ratio
substitutions.replacement: Binary nDCG@10 normalized by 1+1/log2(3); fixed-anchor reward (C-0.446)/(1-0.446) for valid candidates; freshly train the immutable starter as a paired diagnostic
substitutions.reason: Latest human-2 specification. Neither measured baseline nor untouched Tiny sets the anchor. Valid rewards can be negative. Both-supports@2 and question-type slices remain diagnostics.

substitutions.original: Legacy TPU/JAX native model execution and full experiment workspace
substitutions.replacement: Minimal CUDA training overlay and independent trusted retrieval, retaining rendered corpus-row IDs, query_id and retrieved/doc_index output fields
substitutions.reason: The approved fixed architecture supersedes the old single_embedding_retrieval edit surface. Repository source and revision remain declared as required; standalone qualification ships only the new overlay and public assets. A generic compiler may also retain the 8.9 MB read-only historical repository tree.

data.membership: Byte-identical corpus, question, gold and slice files to revision-context/current-task, with only model-derived manifest fields removed. No resampling, repartitioning, relabeling or truncation of panel size.
data.transform: Title plus colon-space plus joined original sentences; deduplicate exact rendered paragraphs, not titles; row-local IDs are independently shuffled.
data.leakage_policy: Preserve original normalized-question/support-title-pair connected groups, whole-group panel partition and training/background exclusions. Training/public/private manifests remain at their corresponding ownership boundary.
data.limitations: Shared corpora, not full Wikipedia or unseen-document generalization. Recovering annotated paragraphs is not answer correctness; inference truncates documents to 256 tokens.
data.solver_visible: Designated training records, public panel and a plain pretrained Tiny only. No private panel, full upstream cache, model-derived negatives, teacher predictions or reference source.

inference.pooling: attention-mask mean including special tokens; float32; L2-normalized
inference.ranking: single-pass cosine descending; ties by ascending corpus row ID
inference.gpu_usage: One GPU for trusted inference, two available; starter uses both for training

budgets.candidate_preparation: Source snapshot is charged to training; data parsing, tokenization and negative mining are also timed. Weight transfer/loading, corpus encoding and sorting are charged to retrieval.

qualification_policy: Compare control and repeated starter/reference public seeds, then three independent one-hour solver trials. Never tune on private results. Do not release if meaningful gains or capacity cannot be demonstrated.
source_license: The reconstructed memory-layers source license was not established in the provided plan. Do not invent a license.

reward_ratio_revision.baseline: fixed calibrated nDCG 0.446; paired measured baseline remains diagnostic
reward_ratio_revision.history: Earlier measurements retain their recorded reward scales.
